recentItems.title: NBC Nightly News with Tom Llamas Full Episode - Sept. 16
recentItems.description:
Tonight: Tragedy in the skies of Los Angeles after a news helicopter crashed while covering another fatal accident. three people, including two members of the NBC Los Angeles family, were killed. Plus, the Fed chair appointed by President Trump raised interest rates to combat inflation. President Trump said he has confidence in Kevin Warsh and wants him to be independent. And seven House Republican voted for a symbolic resolution calling for an end to the Iran war. Vice President Vance urged Americans who voted for President Trump to vote Republican in the midterms even if they disagree on one issue. Also, we're hearing for the first time from a passenger who was duct-taped to his seat after allegedly becoming violent aboard a flight. He told a judge he doesn't remember anything. And police say a caretaker poured bleach into a water bottle and gave it to a victim who is unable to care for himself. The suspect is now facing multiple charges including aggravated battery. And if you have a golden retriever this incident may not be surprising. In San Diego, a break-in shows an intruder making himself comfortable. Video shows the moment the homeowner’s golden retriever brings the robber a toy multiple times and later greets police when they arrive.
